# Changelog entry template

<!-- One entry per change, newest first, in the changelog of the component whose
identifier changes (for example agent-kit/CHANGELOG.md for the agent kit). The axes and
bump rules are in the "Stability and versioning policy" chapter of the specification
(specification/docs/chapters/stability.rst). Replace every <...>. -->

## <date, YYYY-MM-DD>: <new identifier, or "Unreleased">

- **Axis and identifier:** <axis>: <identifier before> -> <identifier after>
- **Kind:** <major | minor | patch | new profile | versioned extension | new schema version |
  editorial>
- **Change:** <one sentence on what changed and why; issue or pull request>
- **Semantic change:** <no | yes, see migration note: path or link>
- **Codes and rule IDs:** <added, deprecated or tombstoned items, or "none">
